highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: PostGREShell vulnerability allows server takeover and Cisco addresses critical vulnerabilities in Nexus 9000 switches and IOS XR. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: The hidden work of modernizing Malwarebytes. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Thomson Reuters court software breach exposes sensitive data in Canada and US. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
